answer_1.quote: Machine translation is increasingly utilized in the translation and localization industry.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs are Czech translations of English source texts, generated by various MT systems and then post-edited by professional translators.

answer_2.quote: We examine in detail the composition of our set of post-editors from the first phase, not of the re-9 viewers.

answer_4.quote: The reviewers classified errors into three categories: accuracy (adequacy), fluency and other. Every comment also had a severity attached (0-neutral, 1-minor, 2-major, 3-critical).
answer_4.guideline: Reviewers were instructed to fix only true errors: wrong translation, inaccuracies, grammar or style errors. Individual translators' preferences were supposed to be avoided.
